definitions.explanation: The process of replacing stale indoor air with fresh outdoor air to maintain air quality.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}を{開|あ}けて{換気|かんき}してください。
examples.english: Please open the window and ventilate.

examples.japanese: {換気|かんき}が{悪|わる}いと{空気|くうき}が{汚|よご}れる。
examples.english: The air gets stale if ventilation is poor.

examples.japanese: {感染|かんせん}{予防|よぼう}のため{定期的|ていきてき}な{換気|かんき}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Regular ventilation is important for infection prevention.

notes:
COVID-19 CONTEXT: {換気|かんき} became a frequently used word during the COVID-19 pandemic as proper ventilation was emphasized as a key preventive measure.

PATTERNS:
・{換気|かんき}する (to ventilate)
・{換気|かんき}をする (to do ventilation)
・{換気|かんき}が{良|よ}い/{悪|わる}い (good/poor ventilation)

EQUIPMENT:
・{換気扇|かんきせん} (ventilation fan, exhaust fan)
・{換気|かんき}{装置|そうち} (ventilation system)
・{換気|かんき}システム (ventilation system)
・{換気口|かんきこう} (ventilation opening, air vent)

RELATED:
・{空調|くうちょう} (air conditioning)
・{通気|つうき} (ventilation, air circulation)
・{空気|くうき}の{入|い}れ{替|か}え (changing the air)
